CustomField.description: Set by Doc_Checklist_Completion_Sync_Flow. TRUE when the linked Document Checklist row (Document_Checklist__c.Booking_Verification_Checklist_Item__c) is Final and not bypassed, whether the document was uploaded manually or came through Ironclad. Cleared when the row returns to Draft or is bypassed. Read-only: do not edit by hand.
